Org A (Telecommunications).query: SELECT "MonthlyCharges", "TotalCharges", "tenure" as tenure_months, "Churn" as churn_status, "Contract" FROM customer_churn WHERE "TotalCharges" IS NOT NULL

Org B (Supply Chain).query: SELECT date, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, AVG("priceMin") as avg_price_min, AVG("priceMax") as avg_price_max, AVG("priceMod") as modal_price FROM wholesale_supply WHERE date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

Org C (Global Superstore).query: SELECT Order_Date as date, Sales as total_sales, Profit as profit, Discount as discount FROM superstore_sales WHERE Order_Date IS NOT NULL
